Casse-tête logique : relie toutes les îl: A logic puzzle: connect all the islands with straight bridges, one or two between neighbouring islands, with no crossings, to form a single archipelago. Each island's number says how many bridges leave it; it turns green when right. Drag to place a bridge, Backspace to undo, random 7 × 7 or 9 × 9 archipelagos and time records.
Ce plugin doit être approuvé par NeoDex: This plugin must be approved by NeoDex to open.
Glisser d'une île vers sa voisine : 1 po: Slide from one island to its neighbor: 1 bridge, 2 bridges, none · Return: cancel
Les ponts ne se croisent jamais, et tout: The bridges never cross, and all the islands must form a single archipelago.
Une île devient verte quand elle a juste: An island turns green when it has just the right number of bridges, red when it has too many.
